mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO billing.invoice_items ( invoice_id, order_item_id, name, quantity, unit, unit_price, vat_rate, position ) VALUES
(#{invoiceId}, #{item.orderItemId}, #{item.name}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.unit}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.vatRate}, #{item.position})
mapper.update:
UPDATE billing.invoice_items SET name = #{name}, quantity = #{quantity}, unit = #{unit}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, vat_rate = #{vatRate}, position = COALESCE(#{position}, position) WHERE id = #{id}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM billing.invoices i WHERE i.id = billing.invoice_items.invoice_id AND i.status = 'DRAFT'::billing.invoice_status )
mapper.select: SELECT , ROUND(ii.quantity * ii.unit_price, 2) AS net, ROUND(ii.quantity * ii.unit_price * ii.vat_rate / 100.0, 2) AS vat, ROUND(ii.quantity * ii.unit_price, 2) + ROUND(ii.quantity * ii.unit_price * ii.vat_rate / 100.0, 2) AS gross FROM billing.invoice_items AS ii WHERE ii.id = #{id}

SELECT , ROUND(ii.quantity * ii.unit_price, 2) AS net, ROUND(ii.quantity * ii.unit_price * ii.vat_rate / 100.0, 2) AS vat, ROUND(ii.quantity * ii.unit_price, 2) + ROUND(ii.quantity * ii.unit_price * ii.vat_rate / 100.0, 2) AS gross FROM billing.invoice_items AS ii WHERE ii.invoice_id = #{invoiceId} ORDER BY ii.position
